title: Open Mic Night @ Garage Taco Bar
event_description: A weekly downtown Binghamton open mic that grew from a handful of friends into a real community night, welcoming poets, singers, rappers and musicians over $3 tacos and tequila.
event_venue_information:
Garage Taco Bar

Garage Taco Bar is a street-food-inspired taco bar and bar in the heart of downtown Binghamton, known for a fun, inclusive menu with vegan and vegetarian options alongside tequila cocktails.

Open Mic Night

Every Tuesday night, Garage hosts an open mic that started small and has quickly grown into a genuine community gathering, welcoming poets, singers, rappers and musicians of every type. The night pairs with $3 tacos and $3 tequila shots, keeping the mood loose and low-pressure.

Other Events

Garage also runs Taco Tuesday specials, an alternating Thursday Quingo Night (trivia meets bingo), and Friday karaoke.

Good to Know

Garage Taco Bar is located at 211 Washington St, Binghamton, NY 13901, in downtown Binghamton.

title: Jazz Jam with Miles Ahead @ Lost Dog Cafe & Lounge
event_description: Binghamton's longest-running jazz night, over 20 years strong, led by the Miles Ahead Jazz Quartet. Musicians and vocalists are welcome to bring an instrument or their voice and sit in.
backline: House band, PA and microphones provided
event_venue_information:
Lost Dog Café & Lounge

Lost Dog Café & Lounge is a longstanding restaurant, bar and event space on Water Street in downtown Binghamton, known for its eclectic calendar of dining, dancing and live entertainment.

Jazz Jam with Miles Ahead

On the first and third Wednesday of each month at 8:00 PM, the Miles Ahead Jazz Quartet leads what the venue calls Binghamton's longest-running jazz night, over 20 years strong. Musicians and vocalists are invited to bring an instrument or their voice and sit in with the house band; there's no cover and no sign-up required.

Other Events

Lost Dog's calendar also includes a Thursday karaoke night, monthly trivia, and a recurring drag showcase, making it one of downtown Binghamton's most active nightlife spots.

Good to Know

Lost Dog Café & Lounge is located at 222 Water St, Binghamton, NY 13901. Because the jazz jam runs on the first and third Wednesday rather than weekly, confirm the date on the venue's calendar before visiting.

title: Poetry Open Mic @ WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center
event_description: A poetry, prose and spoken word open mic on the Bundy Campus led by Poet-in-Residence J. Barrett Wolf, offering performers five to seven minutes for up to three pieces.
venue_name: WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center
event_venue_information:
WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center

WordPlace is a literary center on the southwest corner of the historic Bundy Campus in Binghamton, affiliated with the Bundy Museum of History & Art and dedicated to spoken word, poetry and prose.

Poetry Open Mic

WordPlace hosts a Poetry Open Mic Thursday, led by Bundy Museum Poet-in-Residence J. Barrett Wolf, running from 8:00 PM to 10:00 PM with sign-up beginning at 7:45 PM. Performers get five to seven minutes to share up to three pieces of poetry, prose or spoken word.

Other Events

WordPlace and the adjoining Bundy Museum host a broader calendar of literary and cultural programming, including featured-poet nights and community readings.

Good to Know

WordPlace: The Southern Tier Literary Center is located at 26 Cedar St, Binghamton, NY 13905. Because open mic dates are scheduled periodically rather than every week, check the Bundy Museum's calendar to confirm the next date.
